_comment: Hand-authored Cleric sim mechanics, same schema as the Sorcerer file. Every Num carries confidence. Extra keys (tick_flat_by_rank, spec_effects, class_caps, resource, spec_mechanics, damage_procs, skill_elements, skill_tags) are ignored by from_dict and kept for the sim/UI.

default.source: default 1.0 s; client cast_time is 0 everywhere; calibrate in app

long.source: no Cleric skill is reported as notably long; list left empty until Jon records animations

skill_elements_note: models.Element has no "wind". Wind skills load as element "none" (the builder regex only knows Fire/Water/Earth); the true element is kept here for a later Element extension. Thunder and Lightning / Discharge are overridden to "none" so they do not inherit Earth from Earth's Retribution.
skill_tags_note: manual = pressed by hand, keep out of the macro (Bolt charge, heals, defensives, party buffs, Noble Aura summon); dot and ground make the engine warn about unknown tick ratios; utility tags: defense, cc, mobility, sustain, heal (+ cleanse, resurrect, party-buff, stagger, summon, proc, basic, resource, charge).

specialization_effects_note: Overrides for options the generic text parser gets wrong or cannot value. Options not listed use the parser. Chain children (Thunder and Lightning, Discharge, Divine Punishment) list the parent's options in the client; the parents carry the effects and the children are empty. Cleric options unlock at rank 8/8/8/12/16 (actives) and 5/10/15/20 (stigmas); spec_slot_ranks keeps the engine default 8/12/20.
